blocks.body:
name = "acme/snapshots"
version = "1.0.0"
[[verifier.snapshot]]
run = ""

[[verifier.snapshot]]
run = "pg_dump"
reads = ["var/lib", "/a/../b"]
timeout = "2 min"

[[verifier.snapshot]]
run = "x"
reads = ["/var/lib/postgresql"]
service = "db"

diagnostics.message: [verifier] snapshot[0] needs reads, the absolute paths whose state the command reads: the runtime puts each on a volume when the sandbox starts, and the snapshot runs in a fresh container that sees only those paths. Harbor's collect has no such key, so an imported entry needs them added
[verifier] snapshot[1] reads is a list of absolute paths, without ..
[verifier] snapshot[1] timeout is a duration, such as "2m"
